But the regex for %f in Parser _handle_field: s = r'\d*\.\d+'. That matches any number of digits before and after decimal. So fine.

Actually Python regex group names must be [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*. So hyphen is not allowed. But we can allow hyphen in field names by mapping to underscore.
